before.name: Rosemarie Dominguez
before.description: Rosemarie Dominguez is a Little Village community activist and Chicago 10th District police council member. She told the Chicago Tribune that federal agents detained her on November 6, 2025 while she followed their vehicles and alerted community members to their presence. She reported approximately four hours in custody before release with a violation notice at the Broadview facility. She appeared in federal court on December 8 to contest the allegations.
